Hi Leo,

We have granted you access to the following groups that are part of Priya Nair's access: SYN-GRP-CONFLUENCE-FINANCE, SYN-GRP-FINREP-READ. 

The following groups you requested require your manager's approval before access can be granted and we have noted these for review: SYN-GRP-FINREP-WRITE (Finance Reports editors) and SYN-GRP-PAYROLL-ADMIN (Payroll administrators).

The group SYN-GRP-JIRA-WRITE could not be granted at this time due to the ongoing Jira migration.

Please let us know if you need further assistance.

Thank you,
IT Access Desk
